BiblicalUsage: Ashbel is a son of Benjamin, named three times, in the list of those who went down into Egypt with Jacob, in the census of the wilderness, and in the chronicler's genealogy of Benjamin. His sons are the Ashbelites, and the name is counted in every list.
TheologicalSignificance: A son of Benjamin counted going into Egypt, counted in the wilderness, and counted after the exile tells me that God keeps the tribes by name through every generation, and none is lost on the way.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
